title: Statin use vs death rate from cardiovascular diseases
excerpt: The use of statins in the population, measured in Defined Daily Doses per 1,000 people. This is compared to the reported annual death rate from cardiovascular diseases per 100,000 people, based on the underlying cause listed on death certificates.
